description: BFP4 attention weights at LoFi plus a BFP8 decode CCL payload, with the BFP8 KV cache kept. The two accuracy-neutral switches from the first pass, stacked.

embedding.note: structural: ttnn.embedding needs a ROW_MAJOR BF16 table

norms.note: structural: every RMSNorm weight is packed BF16

ccl.decode_dtype_note: null means the collective carries the activation dtype

provenance.selection_reason: 11 passing configs are not separated from the fastest (38.29 t/s/u) by the ranking metric -- within 0.5% of its median, or with an overlapping measured round range, or both: c08-attn4-kv4-cclbfp8=38.29, c09-kv4-cclbfp8=38.27, c15-attn4-except-first-last-cclbfp8=38.24, c14-attn4-cclbfp8-kv8=38.23, c01-attn4-mlp4-kv8-lofi=38.20, c20-attn4-cclbfp8-kv4-sliding-only=38.20, c07-attn4-except-first-last=38.16, c22-attn4-cclbfp8-kv4-full-attn-only=38.14, c06-decode-ccl-bfp8=38.14, c19-prefill-ccl-bfp8-unfractured-norm=38.10, c05-kv4=38.08. the traced logits-only cross-check separates 4 of the accuracy-neutral candidates from the best but not c14-attn4-cclbfp8-kv8 (44.578), c15-attn4-except-first-last-cclbfp8 (44.564), which agree to within its own measured resolution of 0.038%; among those the decision is the simplest policy: c14-attn4-cclbfp8-kv8. Faster-by-median but not separated, and rejected for a measured full-model top-1 regression to below 0.990: c08-attn4-kv4-cclbfp8 (38.293 t/s/u, top-1 0.970), c09-kv4-cclbfp8 (38.269 t/s/u, top-1 0.970), c20-attn4-cclbfp8-kv4-sliding-only (38.201 t/s/u, top-1 0.980), c22-attn4-cclbfp8-kv4-full-attn-only (38.145 t/s/u, top-1 0.970), c05-kv4 (38.081 t/s/u, top-1 0.970)
provenance.tie_rule: candidates whose measured teacher-forcing round ranges overlap the fastest candidate's, or which are within the tolerance of its median, are not separated by the ranking metric. Within that set, in order: (1) prefer no regression in measured full-model top-1 -- the safer half of the skill's tie rule; (2) drop everything the traced logits-only cross-check separates from its best by more than that metric's own measured resolution, which is how well its two good rounds agree across all candidates rather than a fixed band; (3) among what remains -- genuinely indistinguishable on both metrics -- take the simplest policy, counted as departures from the carried-forward baseline.

thresholds.source: $datatype-sweep defaults (top-1 >= 90 %, top-5 >= 98 %); top-100 held at the readiness expectation the optimized full model already meets (1.000). No user override was given.

provenance.teacher_forcing_measurement_regime: teacher-forcing decode, readiness run_teacher_forcing over 100 generated tokens of readiness_aime24_chat.refpt, batch 1, prompt 204, traced decode (enable_trace=True), token restaged per step; median of 11 rounds
provenance.note: This file is a required input to tt/generator.py::build_generator. To return to the carried-forward optimized-full-model policy, copy doc/datatype_sweep/configs/c00-baseline-attn8-mlp4-kv8-lofi.json over it; nothing else has to change. The post-selection token-out numbers are in doc/datatype_sweep/evidence_perf.json and are the ones later reports and vLLM comparisons should use.
